result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up convergence check for SV-02-001 and SV-02-002. The directly touched rendering paths and tests now close both prior blockers; focused checks, story gate, and epic gate pass.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: `packages/lhc/src/domains/thread-view/internal/render.ts:87-93` now always uses `deterministicTruncation(content)` for at-or-behind-boundary tool results. `packages/lhc/test/view-boundary.test.ts:243-249` and `packages/lhc/test/view-pull.test.ts:310-318` assert that ready `tool_result_summary` content remains stored but is not rendered on that full-band boundary surface.

`packages/lhc/src/domains/thread-view/internal/render.ts:70-74` now serializes recorded tool-call arguments directly with `JSON.stringify` and no truncation. `packages/lhc/test/tool-result-rendering.test.ts:191-210` covers a 240-character tail argument and asserts the full args render with no truncation; a direct render probe also returned `includesFull:true` and `includesTruncated:false`.

verified: AC-2.1/TC-2.1a full-band boundary tool-result rendering uses deterministic truncation, not provider summary content
AC-2.2/TC-2.2a in-threshold tool-result summaries are queued and derived off the intake path
AC-2.3/TC-2.3a-c tier targets and large-tier truncation behavior are covered
AC-2.4/TC-2.4a-b per-tool guidance and outcome metadata are covered
AC-2.5/TC-2.5a-b `tool_call_summary` is removed and tool-call arguments render as recorded on turn and tail surfaces
AC-2.6/TC-2.6a canonical tool-result content remains intact
AC-2.7/TC-2.7a large-tier summaries land ready via deterministic truncation with no inference item
AC-2.8/TC-2.8a terminal in-threshold summary failure lands failed with reason and consumers have truncation fallback coverage

gatesRun.command: cd packages/lhc && pnpm exec vitest run test/tool-result-rendering.test.ts test/view-boundary.test.ts test/view-pull.test.ts

additionalObservations: No fake adapter, placeholder provider path, runtime shim, or non-real production behavior was found in the directly touched Story 2 rendering paths.

`packages/lhc/src/shared/view.ts:75-77` still has stale comment text for compact args and summary-or-truncation wording; runtime behavior and tests now match Story 2, but that comment should be cleaned up when touching the view contract docs next.

`pnpm run verify` and `pnpm run verify-all` still print `NOT-RAN: real-inference (LHC_OPENROUTER_KEY unset)` while exiting 0; Story 2 verification evidence came from deterministic local paths and the configured gates passed.
